blocks.text: Karolina Muchova beat former world number one Naomi Osaka on her ninth match point to reach the quarterfinals of the China Open, triumphant in a tense tie-break on Tuesday in Beijing. Muchova, the seventh seed, overcame 50 unforced errors across the two-hour-and-52-minute match to beat Osaka 7-5, 1-6, 7-6 (9/7). Osaka, the current world number 17, surrendered a three-game lead in the first set after a series of misfired shots in the seventh game.
